derivation.behavior: Verified staging becomes a versioned artifact before publication.
derivation.canonical_behavior: Go freezes writes, verifies, creates ArtifactGeneration and queues publication without conflating user-visible completion.

invariants: Finalization freezes authoritative staging writes before reading bytes.
Only a transport_complete current generation may finalize.
Verified artifact creation and attempt transition to produced_artifact are one SQLite transaction.
Publication preparation requires a produced_artifact attempt and a verified current artifact.
A crash after artifact creation leaves an unpublished artifact recoverable by the publication saga.
Cancellation or checksum failure creates no publishable artifact.
